SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION - SALEM COUNTY
DOCKET NO.
F-001336-26
SHERIFF NO.
26000294
PLAINTIFF -
Freedom Mortgage Corporation
DEFENDANT -
Kathryn A. Watson, Et Al.
By virtue of a Writ of Execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public venue at the Salem County Courthouse, situated at No. 92 Market Street, in the City of Salem, New Jersey on
Monday,
November 16, 2026
at
2 o’clock
in the afternoon, ALL the following lot, tract or parcel of land and premises, situate, lying and being in the Township of Pennsville, in the County of Salem and State of New Jersey, bounded and described as follows:
Municipality: Pennsville
County of Salem
State of New Jersey
Street and Street No.: 112 Quaker Road Pennsville, NJ 08070
Tax Block and Lot No.: Block 3605, Lot 7
Dimensions of Lot (approximately): 80FT. X 100FT.
Nearest Cross Street: Delaware Drive
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the offices of the County Clerk and the Sheriff of Salem County.
The approximate amount of the judgment to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of $218,608.72 together with the costs of this sale.
The approximate upset price is $234,925.85.
The upset price may be subject to further Orders of additional sums.
Occupancy Status: Occupied by unknown
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Pursuant to 28 USC 2410(c) this sale is subject to a 1 year right of redemption held by the United States of America by virtue of its lien:
Subordinate Mortgage: Kathryn A. Watson and Brandon Eugene Preston to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 06/28/2023 and recorded 07/14/2023 in Book 4670, Page 1388, to secure $28,650.86
Subordinate Mortgage: Kathryn A. Watson and Brandon Eugene Preston to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 12/22/2023 and recorded 01/11/2024 in Book 4685, Page 1593, to secure $7,412.93.
Subordinate Mortgage: Kathryn A. Watson and Brandon Eugene Preston to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 05/20/2024 and recorded 05/28/2024 in Book 4696, Page 1519, o secure $9,389.50.
Subordinate Mortgage: Kathryn A. Watson and Brandon Eugene Preston to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 11/19/2024 and recorded 12/18/2024 in book 4715, Page 459, to secure $13,293.86.
Subordinate Mortgage: Kathryn A. Watson and Brandon Eugene Preston to Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, dated 06/21/2025 and recorded 07/07/2025 in Book 4733, Page 172, to secure $923.59
Terms of Sale: 20% of bid in cash, certified check or cashiers check from the successful bidder upon conclusion of sale. The Sheriff’s Office cash limit is $1,000.00 The balance is due within 30 days of the date of sale.
Surplus Money:
If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to the Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
Brock & Scott, PLLC
, Attorneys for Plaintiff
Charles M. Miller, Sheriff
